records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the short nameplate. Sera and Camille use the runtime given name in direct address.
Lil Argot is the nameplate. Camille calls her Lil at the reunion, where she takes him back aboard.
Maria Li is the header. She gives the full approved Maria Huamei Li when Hodram asks her identity.
Camille Overijssel is the approved identity. The speakers addressing him use Camille.
Xien Yan is the established nameplate. His polite invitation withholds whom Hodram is going to meet.
Gerhard Adernkatz is the officer who asks whether Hodram is sure and later reports the recovered assets.
Charles Rochefort has the final silent reaction as Hodram lets Sera go.
Manuel Almeida has his own silent reaction in the farewell.
Sera Shahrbaraz is the short header. The source symbols are restricted to her exchanges with Sirwood.
Sirwood Eme is the nameplate. Sera's immediate reaction uses his given name Sirwood.
Port Worker keeps the source occupation. His familiar address to Camille adds no kinship or title.
